title: 第23章 一门双妖孽李长生准备纳妾了第24章 李长生这盘棋太大了儿子修仙女儿养老
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 执事又问了好几个关于昨晚的事情。
李长生都以一问三不知的方法应付过去。
执事没有得到任何有用的信息，眉头紧锁。
又用神识在屋内查探了几次，都没有什么发现。
再加上李长生一副半死不活、寿元将尽的衰样。
怎么看都不像是神秘青铜修士的样子。
随着雷烈的点头，就意味着这次问话，结束了。
雷烈跟过来问的目的，是判断问询者是否伪装，以及是否说真话的。
那就真的看不出破绽了。
这时雷烈则站起来，好像想到了什么，转过头，目光忽然落在江翠萍身上。
是落在江翠萍旁边的两个孩子上。
虽然两个小孩，年纪尚小，但眼睛灵动，隐隐透着一股灵气。
不知道为何，我竟然连续生了两次爱才之心。
而且是对两位尚未测灵根的孩子。
难道这就是冥冥中的缘分吗？
李长生闻言，心头咯噔一下，该不会雷长老看出了什么吧？
雷烈走过去，伸手在平平的肩膀上捏了捏，眼中闪过一丝讶异。
content_en:
Deacon: "..."
Li Changsheng: "..."
Deacon: "..."
Li Changsheng: "..."
…
Immediately afterwards.
The deacon asked several more questions about last night.
Li Changsheng dealt with it by asking questions and not knowing.
The deacon didn't get any useful information and frowned.
I searched the house several times with my spiritual sense, but found nothing.
In addition, Li Changsheng looked like he was half dead and about to expire.
No matter how he looks, he doesn't look like the mysterious bronze monk.
Immediately ready to retreat.
The deacon turned his head.
Speaking to Elder Lei Lie:
"Elder."
"The inquiry has ended."
"Yeah." Lei Lie nodded lightly.
With Lei Lie's nod, it meant that this interview was over.
Really nothing.
The purpose of Lei Lie's questioning was to determine whether the inquirer was disguising and telling the truth.
Lei Lie couldn't even see the flaw.
Then you really can't see the flaw.
At this time, Lei Lie stood up and seemed to have thought of something. He turned his head and his eyes suddenly fell on Jiang Cuiping.
wrong.
To be more precise.
It fell on the two children next to Jiang Cuiping.
An ordinary tiger's head and a tiger's brain.
Ningning pink carving jade carving.
Although the two children are still young, their eyes are smart and there is a faint aura.
He doesn't look like a mortal at first glance.
Ideas just came to mind.
emerged again.
I don’t know why, but I fell in love with talents twice in a row.
And it was for two children who had not yet tested their spiritual roots.
Could it be that this is fate?
"Is this your child?"
When Li Changsheng heard this, his heart skipped a beat. Could it be that Elder Lei saw something?
It shouldn’t be!
Li Changsheng felt a little panicked.
But the surface is still submissive:
"Yes..."
"These are an old pair of children."
Lei Lie walked over, stretched out his hand and pinched Ping Ping's shoulder, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
"The bones are good."
title_en: Chapter 23 Li Changsheng, a double monster, is ready to take a concubine. Chapter 24 Li Changsheng’s game of chess is too big. His son is cultivating immortality and his daughter is taking care of him in old age.
